newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Bank Ukraina to sell shares to EBRD.
newsitem.headline: Bank Ukraina to sell shares to EBRD.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) plans to buy shares in Bank Ukraina -- one of Ukraine's largest-- an official from the Ukrainian bank said on Monday.

The official, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters the EBRD would purchase no more than a 17-18 percent share from the bank. He added that the two sides were expected to sign an agreement in the near future.
The official also said that Bank Ukraina was told last week that it would have access to a 100 million Ecu credit from the EBRD to develop small- and medium-sized businesses.

Mykola Shvets, deputy head of Bank Ukraina's securities and markets department, said the bank planned to increase its authorised capital to 61.7 million hryvnia from 46.7 million hryvnia through a new share issue.
It was not clear whether the EBRD shares would derive from the capital increase.
